_comment: Calibrated LCD boxes per camera position. find_display_region() uses the last entry whose 'since' date is <= the snapshot date in the filename (cam01-snapshot-YYYYMMDDhhmmss.jpg); filenames without a date use the last entry (the current camera). Snapshots older than the first entry fall back to edge detection. lcd_box is [x, y, w, h] in pixels of image_size and frames the LCD window the way the edge detector does on older snapshots.
